title: Tax Filings
description: Prepare government tax returns from the ledger and preserve what was filed.
empty: Choose a return and a period, then compute.

noForms.title: No tax returns configured
noForms.description: Import a jurisdiction pack or create a return in Setup → Taxes.

submission.title: How to file this return
submission.description: Use the configured filing channel and action below after reviewing the return.
submission.exportNotice: Working-copy exports are for review and records. They are not government submission files unless the configured filing method explicitly says otherwise.
submission.gst34Notice: GST34 is normally entered in CRA Account or NETFILE. CRA's uploadable .tax file can only be produced by CRA-certified software; PDF, CSV, and Excel are not accepted filing formats.

history.title: Previous filings
history.description: Versioned, immutable snapshots of prepared and submitted returns.
history.empty: No saved filings match these filters.
history.markFiledHint: Only mark this snapshot filed after the government accepts it. This action cannot be undone.
